def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    # find 2-line row
    lr=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==2 for v in g[r])][0]
    # find object cells (non-0/1/2? object color = most common non-line non-bg)
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=max((v for v in cnt if v!=2), key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (0,2,bg) or (g[r][c]==0 and bg!=0)]
    # simpler: object = cells not equal to bg and not equal to 2, plus 0-holes only if 0 isn't bg
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=2]
    if not cells: return g
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]
    top,bot=min(rs),max(rs)
    colset={(c) for r,c in cells}
    shape={(r-top,c) for r,c in cells}
    objcol=g[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    side = -1 if bot<lr else 1
    # clear object
    for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=bg
    # place adjacent to line
    nh=bot-top+1
    if side==-1:
        newtop=lr-nh
        newline=newtop-1
    else:
        newtop=lr+1
        newline=newtop+nh
    for r,c in shape:
        g[newtop+r][c]=objcol
    for c in range(w): g[newline][c]=8
    return g
